overview: The Lexus LX is the flagship body-on-frame SUV, sharing platform with the Toyota Land Cruiser/Sequoia. The LX 700h introduced for MY2025 is the first hybrid LX, with i-FORCE MAX twin-turbo V6 hybrid producing 457 hp. Sources: https://www.lexus.com/models/LX , https://pressroom.lexus.com/2025-lexus-lx/
